scope: Final sealed R4 archive, manifest, bootstrap, admitted preseal receipt, source-preserving delta, and pre-mount authorization guard. This is not a provider admission or dispatch authorization.

validation.source_delta_review: R3 archive was byte-compared with R4: all 89 prior entries are retained; exactly one conditional root receipt is added; only the existing release gate and 14 worker descriptors are changed. The validator confirms all non-gate science fields in each descriptor remain identical to R3.
validation.pre_mount_gate: Kernel verifies the archive and embedded receipt/gate binding before mounting external inputs and before starting the driver. The driver checks paired-profile evidence before the fit stage.
validation.review_limits: Read-only static/package validation under scripts/limited at 50% CPU, 1 thread, 700 MB memory, 120 seconds. Root separately reported private asset READY v1 readback byte-identical to the reviewed archive; this reviewer did not call the provider.

dispatch_boundary: Package integrity passes. Root retains the separate live quota, readiness, admission, and dispatch decision; this receipt does not authorize a fit or provider action.
